scripts.text:
[Perchik]
I can ^0055FFsign your name^000000 on almost any rare item you hold.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
我几乎可以在您持有的任何稀有物品上^0055FF签下您的名字^000000。

scripts.text: Tell me more...
scripts.translation: 告诉我更多...

scripts.text: Sign my items, please!
scripts.translation: 请给我的物品签名！

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
I can put your name on any slotless equipment or weapon.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
我可以在任何没有卡槽的装备或武器上签下您的名字。

scripts.text:

 ~ {0}x {1}
 ~ {2} Zeny
 ~ {3} Zeny per refine
scripts.translation:

 ~ {0}x {1}
 ~ {2} Zeny
 ~ 每次强化 {3} Zeny

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
I work for free, but...
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
我免费工作，但是...

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Alas, I have 12 hungry children
and a very angry wife.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
唉，我有12个饥饿的孩子
和一个非常生气的妻子。

scripts.text:

Or it was 12 angry children
and a very hungry wife...
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
或者是12个生气的孩子
和一个非常饥饿的妻子...

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Show me your items to sign...
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
请给我看看您要签名的物品...

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Nothing is equipped there!
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
那里没有装备任何物品！

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Alas, this item's already signed.
I would never touch a master's work.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
唉，这件物品已经签过名了。
我绝不会动师父的作品。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
A card? Here?!
As I said before, I don't sign items with cards.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
卡片？在这里？！
正如我之前所说，我不给带有卡片的物品签名。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Sorry, I don't sign slotted items.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
抱歉，我不给有卡槽的物品签名。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Sorry, I don't sign rental items!
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
抱歉，我不给租赁物品签名！
